title.zh: 卷三十一 志第一: 營衞志上
title.raw: 卷三十一 志第一: 營衞志上 Volume 31 Treatises 1: Management of Guards 1

sentences.zh: 營衛誌上

translations.literal: Treatise on Camps and Guards, Part 1
translations.idiomatic: Treatise on Camps and Guards, Part 1

sentences.zh: 上古之世，草衣木食，巢居穴處，熙熙於於，不求不爭。

translations.literal: In high antiquity's age, grass clothes and tree food, nesting in trees and dwelling in caves, happy and at ease, not seeking and not striving.
translations.idiomatic: In high antiquity people wore grass and ate from trees, nested in trees and dwelt in caves, happy and at ease, neither seeking nor striving.

sentences.zh: 爰自炎帝政衰，蚩尤作亂，始制干戈，以毒天下。

translations.literal: From when the Flame Emperor's government declined, Chiyou made disorder, and weapons were first made to poison all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: From when the reign of the Flame Emperor declined and Chiyou raised disorder, weapons were first fashioned to poison the realm.

sentences.zh: 軒轅氏作，戮之涿鹿之阿。

translations.literal: The Yellow Emperor arose and executed him at the slope of Zhuolu.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow Emperor arose, he slew him at the foot of Zhuolu.

sentences.zh: 處則象吻於宮，行則縣旄於纛，以為天下萬世戒。

translations.literal: At rest then elephant tusks in the palace; on the march then yak tails hung on the banners, taking this as a warning to all under heaven for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: At rest he displayed elephant tusks in the palace; on the march he hung yak tails on the banners, as a warning to all under heaven for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 於是師兵營衛，不得不設矣。

translations.literal: Thus armies, camps, and guards could not but be established.
translations.idiomatic: Thus armies, camps, and guards had to be established.

sentences.zh: 冀州以南，歷洪水之變，夏後始制城郭。

translations.literal: South of Ji prefecture, passing through the flood's transformation, the Xia ruler first made walls and cities.
translations.idiomatic: South of Ji prefecture, after the transformation wrought by the Great Flood, the Xia first established walls and cities.

sentences.zh: 其人土著而居綏服之中，外奮武衛，內揆文教，守在四邊。

translations.literal: Its people settled natively and dwelt within the pacified domain, outward exerting military guard, inward aligning civil teaching, keeping defense on the four borders.
translations.idiomatic: Its people settled as natives within the pacified domain, exerting military guard without and aligning civil teaching within, keeping defense on the four borders.

sentences.zh: 營衛之設，以備非常而已。

translations.literal: The establishment of camps and guards was only to prepare against the unexpected.
translations.idiomatic: The establishment of camps and guards was only to prepare for the unexpected.

sentences.zh: 並、營以北，勁風多寒，隨陽遷徙，歲無寧居，曠土萬里，寇賊奸宄，乘隙而作。

translations.literal: North of Bing and Ying, fierce winds and much cold; following the yang they migrated, years without peaceful dwelling, vast earth ten thousand li, bandits and villains seizing gaps to act.
translations.idiomatic: North of Bing and Ying, fierce winds and bitter cold; following the sun they migrated, year without settled dwelling, vast earth ten thousand li, bandits and villains seizing gaps to act.

sentences.zh: 營衛之設，以為常然。

translations.literal: The establishment of camps and guards was taken as the constant norm.
translations.idiomatic: The establishment of camps and guards was taken as the norm.

sentences.zh: 其勢然也。

translations.literal: Such was the tendency.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the situation.

sentences.zh: 有遼始大，設制尤密。

translations.literal: From when Liao first grew great, its institutions were especially dense.
translations.idiomatic: When Liao first grew great, its institutions were especially dense.

sentences.zh: 居有宮衛，謂之斡魯朵，出有行營，謂之捺缽；

translations.literal: In residence there were palace guards, called orudo; on departure there were traveling camps, called napo;
translations.idiomatic: In residence there were palace guards, called orudo (mobile palace encampments); on departure there were traveling camps, called napo (imperial seasonal encampments);

sentences.zh: 分鎮邊圉，謂之部族。

translations.literal: Distributed to guard the border marches, called tribal divisions.
translations.idiomatic: distributed to guard the frontiers, called tribal divisions.

sentences.zh: 有事則以攻戰為務，閑暇則以畋漁為生。

translations.literal: When there was business then attack and battle were the task; in leisure then hunting and fishing were the livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: When there was business, attack and battle were the task; in leisure, hunting and fishing were the livelihood.

sentences.zh: 無日不營，無在不衛。

translations.literal: No day without camping, no place without guarding.
translations.idiomatic: No day without camping, no place without guarding.

sentences.zh: 立國規模，莫重於此。

translations.literal: In the scale of founding a state, nothing was heavier than this.
translations.idiomatic: In the scale of founding a state, nothing weighed more than this.

sentences.zh: 作《營衛志》。

translations.literal: They composed the "Treatise on Camps and Guards."
translations.idiomatic: The "Treatise on Camps and Guards" was composed.

sentences.zh: ○宮衛

translations.literal: ○ Palace Guards
translations.idiomatic: ○ Palace Guards

sentences.zh: 遼國之法：天子踐位，置宮衛，分州縣，析部族，設官府，籍戶口，備兵馬。

translations.literal: Liao state's law: when the Son of Heaven took the throne, palace guards were set up, prefectures and counties divided, tribal divisions analyzed, government offices established, household registers recorded, troops and horses prepared.
translations.idiomatic: Liao law: when the Son of Heaven assumed the throne, palace guards were established, prefectures and counties divided, tribal divisions analyzed, government offices set up, household registers made, and troops and horses prepared.

sentences.zh: 崩則扈從后妃宮帳，以奉陵寢。

translations.literal: On demise the entourage followed the empress and consorts' palace tents to serve the imperial tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On death the entourage followed the empress and consorts' palace tents to attend the imperial tomb.

sentences.zh: 有調發，則丁壯從戎事，老弱居守。

translations.literal: When there were levies, able-bodied men followed military affairs and old and weak remained on guard.
translations.idiomatic: When levies were issued, able-bodied men followed military affairs while the old and weak remained on guard.

sentences.zh: 太祖曰弘義宮，應天皇后曰長寧宮，太宗曰永興宮，世宗曰積慶宮。

translations.literal: Taizu was called Hongyi Palace, Empress Yingtian was called Changning Palace, Taizong was called Yongxing Palace, Shizong was called Jiqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu: Hongyi Palace; Empress Yingtian: Changning Palace; Taizong: Yongxing Palace; Shizong: Jiqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 穆宗曰延昌宮，景宗曰彰湣宮，承天太后曰崇德宮，聖宗曰興聖宮，興宗曰延慶宮，道宗曰太和宮，天祚曰永昌宮。

translations.literal: Muzong: Yanchang Palace; Jingzong: Zhangmin Palace; Empress Chengtian: Chongde Palace; Shengzong: Xingsheng Palace; Xingzong: Yanqing Palace; Daozong: Taihe Palace; Tianzuo: Yongchang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong: Yanchang Palace; Jingzong: Zhangmin Palace; Empress Chengtian: Chongde Palace; Shengzong: Xingsheng Palace; Xingzong: Yanqing Palace; Daozong: Taihe Palace; Tianzuo: Yongchang Palace.

sentences.zh: 又孝文皇太弟有敦睦宮，丞相耶律隆運有文忠王府。

translations.literal: Also the Literary Emperor's imperial younger brother had Dunmu Palace; Chancellor Yelü Longyun had the Wenzhong Princely Residence.
translations.idiomatic: Also the Literary Emperor's younger brother had Dunmu Palace, and Chancellor Yelü Longyun had the Wenzhong Princely Residence.

sentences.zh: 凡州三十八，縣十，提轄司四十一，石烈二十三，瓦裏七十四，抹裏九十八，得裏二，閘撒十九。

translations.literal: Totaling 38 prefectures, 10 counties, 41 supervisory offices, 23 shile, 74 wali, 98 moli, 2 deli, and 19 zhazha.
translations.idiomatic: In all there were 38 prefectures, 10 counties, 41 supervisory offices, 23 shile, 74 wali, 98 moli, 2 deli, and 19 zhazha.

sentences.zh: 為正戶八萬，蕃漢轉戶十二萬三千，共二十萬三千戶。

translations.literal: As regular households eighty thousand, tribal and Han rotational households one hundred twenty-three thousand, together two hundred three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: There were 80,000 regular households, 123,000 tribal and Han rotational households, 203,000 households in total.

sentences.zh: 算斡魯朵，太祖置。

translations.literal: Suan orudo, Taizu established.
translations.idiomatic: The Suan orudo, established by Taizu.

sentences.zh: 國語心腹曰『算』，宮曰『斡魯朵』。

translations.literal: National language: heart-and-core is called "suan"; palace is called "orudo."
translations.idiomatic: In the national language "heart and core" is suan; "palace" is orudo.

sentences.zh: 是為弘義宮。

translations.literal: This was the Hongyi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Hongyi Palace.

sentences.zh: 以心腹之衛置，益以渤海俘，錦州戶。

translations.literal: Set up using the core bodyguard, augmented by Bohai captives and households of Jin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It was established from the core bodyguard, augmented by Bohai captives and households of Jin prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其斡魯朵在臨潢府，陵寢在祖州東南二十里。

translations.literal: Its orudo was at Linhuang prefecture; the tomb was twenty li southeast of Zu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Its orudo was at Linhuang prefecture; the tomb was twenty li southeast of Zu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正戶八千，蕃漢轉戶七千，出騎軍六千。

translations.literal: Regular households 8,000; tribal and Han rotational households 7,000; producing 6,000 cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Regular households 8,000; tribal and Han rotational households 7,000; fielding 6,000 cavalry.

sentences.zh: 州五：錦、祖、嚴、祺、銀。

translations.literal: Prefectures five: Jin, Zu, Yan, Qi, and Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Five prefectures: Jin, Zu, Yan, Qi, and Yin.

sentences.zh: 縣一：富義。

translations.literal: County one: Fuyi.
translations.idiomatic: One county: Fuyi.

sentences.zh: 提轄司四：南京、西京、奉聖州、平州。

translations.literal: Four supervisory offices: Nanjing, Xijing, Fengsheng prefecture, and Ping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Four supervisory offices: Nanjing, Xijing, Fengsheng prefecture, and Ping prefecture.

sentences.zh: 石烈二：曰須，曰速魯。

translations.literal: Two shile: called Xu and called Sulu.
translations.idiomatic: Two shile: called Xu and called Sulu.

sentences.zh: 瓦裏四：曰合不，曰撻撒，曰慢押，曰虎池。

translations.literal: Four wali: called Hebu, called Tasa, called Manya, and called Huchi.
translations.idiomatic: Four wali: called Hebu, called Tasa, called Manya, and called Huchi.

sentences.zh: 抹裏四：曰膻，曰預墩，曰鶻突，曰糾裏闡。

translations.literal: Four moli: called Shan, called Yudun, called Gutu, and called Jiulichan.
translations.idiomatic: Four moli: called Shan, called Yudun, called Gutu, and called Jiulichan.

sentences.zh: 得裏二：曰述壘北。

translations.literal: Two deli: called Shulei North.
translations.idiomatic: Two deli: called Shulei North.

sentences.zh: 曰述壘南。

translations.literal: Called Shulei South.
translations.idiomatic: and called Shulei South.

sentences.zh: 國阿輦斡魯朵，太宗置。

translations.literal: Guoalian orudo, Taizong established.
translations.idiomatic: The Guoalian orudo, established by Taizong.

sentences.zh: 收國曰「國阿輦」。

translations.literal: National language it is called "Guoalian."
translations.idiomatic: In the national language it is called "Guoalian."

sentences.zh: 是為永興宮，初名孤穩斡魯朵。

translations.literal: This was the Yongxing Palace, originally named the Guwen orudo.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Yongxing Palace, originally named the Guwen orudo.

sentences.zh: 以太祖平渤海俘戶，東京、懷州提轄司及雲州懷仁縣、澤州灤河縣等戶置。

translations.literal: Set up using Taizu's Bohai captives, the Tokyo and Huaizhou supervisory offices, and households of Huairen county in Yun prefecture, Luanhe county in Ze prefecture, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: It was established from Taizu's Bohai captives, the Tokyo and Huaizhou supervisory offices, and households of Huairen county in Yun prefecture, Luanhe county in Ze prefecture, and the like.

sentences.zh: 其斡魯朵在遊古河側。

translations.literal: Its orudo was on the bank of the Yougu River.
translations.idiomatic: Its orudo was on the bank of the Yougu River.

sentences.zh: 陵寢在懷州南三十里。

translations.literal: The tomb was thirty li south of Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The tomb was thirty li south of Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 正戶三千，番漢轉戶七千，出騎軍五千。

translations.literal: Regular households 3,000; tribal and Han rotational households 7,000; producing 5,000 cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Regular households 3,000; tribal and Han rotational households 7,000; fielding 5,000 cavalry.

sentences.zh: 州四：懷、黔、開、來。

translations.literal: Prefectures four: Huai, Qian, Kai, and Lai.
translations.idiomatic: Four prefectures: Huai, Qian, Kai, and Lai.

sentences.zh: 縣二：保和、灤河。

translations.literal: Counties two: Baohe and Luanhe.
translations.idiomatic: Two counties: Baohe and Luanhe.

sentences.zh: 提轄司四：南京、西京、奉聖州、平州。

translations.literal: Four supervisory offices: Nanjing, Xijing, Fengsheng prefecture, and Ping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Four supervisory offices: Nanjing, Xijing, Fengsheng prefecture, and Ping prefecture.

sentences.zh: 石烈一：北女古。

translations.literal: One shile: North Nügu.
translations.idiomatic: One shile: North Nügu.

sentences.zh: 瓦裏四：曰抹，曰母，曰合李只，曰述壘。

translations.literal: Four wali: called Mo, called Mu, called Helizhi, and called Shulei.
translations.idiomatic: Four wali: called Mo, called Mu, called Helizhi, and called Shulei.

sentences.zh: 抹裏十三：曰述壘軫，曰大隔蔑，曰小隔蔑，曰母，曰歸化不術，曰唐括，曰吐谷，曰百爾瓜忒，曰合魯不只，曰移馬不只，曰膻，曰清滯，曰速穩。

translations.literal: Thirteen moli: called Shuleizhen, called Dagejie, called Xiaogejie, called Mu, called Guihuabushu, called Tangkuo, called Tugu, called Bai'erguate, called Helubuzhi, called Yimabuzhi, called Shan, called Qingzhi, and called Suwen.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen moli: called Shuleizhen, called Dagejie, called Xiaogejie, called Mu, called Guihuabushu, called Tangkuo, called Tugu, called Bai'erguate, called Helubuzhi, called Yimabuzhi, called Shan, called Qingzhi, and called Suwen.

sentences.zh: 閘撒七：曰伯德部，曰守狘，曰穴骨只，曰合不頻尼，曰虎裏狘，曰耶裏只挾室，曰僧隱令公。

translations.literal: Seven zhazha: called Bodebu, called Shouhuo, called Xueguzhi, called Hebupinni, called Hulihuo, called Yelizhijieshi, and called Sengyinlinggong.
translations.idiomatic: Seven zhazha: called Bodebu, called Shouhuo, called Xueguzhi, called Hebupinni, called Hulihuo, called Yelizhijieshi, and called Sengyinlinggong.

sentences.zh: 耶魯碗斡魯朵，世宗置。

translations.literal: Yeluwan orudo, Shizong established.
translations.idiomatic: The Yeluwan orudo, established by Shizong.

sentences.zh: 興盛曰「耶魯碗」。

translations.literal: National language "flourishing" is "Yeluwan."
translations.idiomatic: In the national language "flourishing" is "Yeluwan."

sentences.zh: 是為積慶宮。

translations.literal: This was the Jiqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Jiqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 以文獻皇帝衛從及太祖俘戶，及雲州提轄司，並高、宜等州戶置。

translations.literal: Set up using the Literary Emperor's guard retinue and Taizu's captives, the Yun prefecture supervisory office, and households of Gao, Yi, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It was established from the Literary Emperor's guard retinue and Taizu's captives, the Yun prefecture supervisory office, and households of Gao, Yi, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 其斡魯朵在土河東，陵寢在長寧宮北。

translations.literal: Its orudo was east of the Tu River; the tomb was north of Changning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Its orudo was east of the Tu River; the tomb was north of Changning Palace.

sentences.zh: 正戶五千，蕃漢轉戶八千，出騎軍八千。

translations.literal: Regular households 5,000; tribal and Han rotational households 8,000; producing 8,000 cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Regular households 5,000; tribal and Han rotational households 8,000; fielding 8,000 cavalry.

sentences.zh: 州三：康、顯、宜。

translations.literal: Prefectures three: Kang, Xian, and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Three prefectures: Kang, Xian, and Yi.

sentences.zh: 縣一：山東。

translations.literal: County one: Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: One county: Shandong.

sentences.zh: 提轄司四。

translations.literal: Supervisory offices: four.
translations.idiomatic: Four supervisory offices.

sentences.zh: 石烈一：兮臘。

translations.literal: One shile: Xila.
translations.idiomatic: One shile: Xila.

sentences.zh: 瓦裏八：曰達撒，曰合不，曰吸烈，曰逼裏，曰潭馬，曰槊不，曰耶裏直，曰耶魯兀也。

translations.literal: Eight wali: called Dasa, called Hebu, called Xilie, called Bili, called Tanma, called Shuobu, called Yelizhi, and called Yeluwuye.
translations.idiomatic: Eight wali: called Dasa, called Hebu, called Xilie, called Bili, called Tanma, called Shuobu, called Yelizhi, and called Yeluwuye.

sentences.zh: 抹裏十：曰紇斯直，曰蠻葛，曰厥裏，曰潭馬忒，曰出懶，曰速忽魯碗，曰牒裏得，曰閻馬，曰叠裏特，曰女古。

translations.literal: Ten moli: called Hesizhi, called Mange, called Jueli, called Tanmate, called Chulan, called Suhuluwan, called Dielide, called Yanma, called Dielite, and called Nügu.
translations.idiomatic: Ten moli: called Hesizhi, called Mange, called Jueli, called Tanmate, called Chulan, called Suhuluwan, called Dielide, called Yanma, called Dielite, and called Nügu.

sentences.zh: 蒲速碗斡魯朵，應天皇太后置。

translations.literal: Pusuwan orudo, Empress Yingtian established.
translations.idiomatic: The Pusuwan orudo, established by Empress Yingtian.

sentences.zh: 興隆曰「蒲速碗」。

translations.literal: National language "prosperity" is "Pusuwan."
translations.idiomatic: In the national language "prosperity" is "Pusuwan."

sentences.zh: 是為長寧宮。

translations.literal: This was the Changning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Changning Palace.

sentences.zh: 以遼州及海濱縣等戶置。

translations.literal: Set up using households of Liaozhou and Haibin county and the like.
translations.idiomatic: It was established from households of Liaozhou and Haibin county and the like.

sentences.zh: 其斡魯朵在高州，陵寢在龍化州東一百里。

translations.literal: Its orudo was at Gaozhou; the tomb was a hundred li east of Longhua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Its orudo was at Gaozhou; the tomb was a hundred li east of Longhua prefecture.

sentences.zh: 世宗分屬讓國皇帝宮院。

translations.literal: Shizong apportioned part of it to the palace establishment of the Emperor Who Yielded the State.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong apportioned part of it to the palace establishment of the Emperor Who Yielded the State.

sentences.zh: 正戶七千，蕃漢轉戶六千，出騎軍五千。

translations.literal: Regular households 7,000; tribal and Han rotational households 6,000; producing 5,000 cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Regular households 7,000; tribal and Han rotational households 6,000; fielding 5,000 cavalry.

sentences.zh: 州四：遼、儀坤、遼西、顯。

translations.literal: Prefectures four: Liao, Yikun, Liaoxi, and Xian.
translations.idiomatic: Four prefectures: Liao, Yikun, Liaoxi, and Xian.

sentences.zh: 縣三：奉先、歸義、定霸。

translations.literal: Three counties: Fengxian, Guiyi, and Dingba.
translations.idiomatic: Three counties: Fengxian, Guiyi, and Dingba.

sentences.zh: 提轄司四。

translations.literal: Supervisory offices: four.
translations.idiomatic: Four supervisory offices.

sentences.zh: 石烈一：北女古。

translations.literal: One shile: North Nügu.
translations.idiomatic: One shile: North Nügu.

sentences.zh: 瓦裏六：曰潭馬，曰合不，曰達撒，曰慢押，曰耶裏只，曰渾只。

translations.literal: Six wali: called Tanma, called Hebu, called Dasa, called Manya, called Yelizhi, and called Hunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Six wali: called Tanma, called Hebu, called Dasa, called Manya, called Yelizhi, and called Hunzhi.

sentences.zh: 抹裏十三：曰渾得移鄰稍瓦只，曰合四卑臘因鐵裏卑稍只，曰奪羅果只，曰拿葛只，曰合裏只，曰婆渾昆母溫，曰阿魯埃得本，曰東廝裏門，曰西廝裏門，曰東钁裏，曰西钁裏，曰牒得只，曰滅母鄰母。

translations.literal: Thirteen moli: called Hundeyilinshaowazhi, called Hesibeilayintielibeishaozhi, called Duoluoguozhi, called Nagezhi, called Helizhi, called Pohunkunmuwen, called Aluaideben, called East Silimen, called West Silimen, called East Jueli, called West Jueli, called Diedezhi, and called Miemulinmu.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen moli: called Hundeyilinshaowazhi, called Hesibeilayintielibeishaozhi, called Duoluoguozhi, called Nagezhi, called Helizhi, called Pohunkunmuwen, called Aluaideben, called East Silimen, called West Silimen, called East Jueli, called West Jueli, called Diedezhi, and called Miemulinmu.

sentences.zh: 奪裏本斡魯朵，穆宗置。

translations.literal: Duoliben orudo, Muzong established.
translations.idiomatic: The Duoliben orudo, established by Muzong.

sentences.zh: 是為延昌宮。

translations.literal: This was the Yanchang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Yanchang Palace.

sentences.zh: 討平曰「奪裏本」。

sentences.zh: 瓦裏六：曰乙辛，曰得裏，曰奚烈直，曰大潭馬，曰小潭馬，曰與墩。

translations.literal: Six wali: called Yixin, called Deli, called Xiliezhi, called Great Tanma, called Small Tanma, and called Yudun.
translations.idiomatic: Six wali: called Yixin, called Deli, called Xiliezhi, called Great Tanma, called Small Tanma, and called Yudun.

sentences.zh: 抹裏二：曰潭馬抹乖，曰柳實。

translations.literal: Two moli: called Tanma Mogai and called Liushi.
translations.idiomatic: Two moli: called Tanma Mogai and called Liushi.

sentences.zh: 閘撒二：曰耳晨頻你，曰打裏頻你。

translations.literal: Two zhazha: called Erchenpinni and called Dalipinni.
translations.idiomatic: Two zhazha: called Erchenpinni and called Dalipinni.

sentences.zh: 大丞相晉國王耶律隆運，本韓氏，名德讓。

translations.literal: Grand Chancellor and Prince of Jin Yelü Longyun was originally Han clan, named Derang.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Chancellor and Prince of Jin Yelü Longyun was originally of the Han clan, named Derang.

sentences.zh: 以功賜國姓，出宮籍，隸橫帳季父房。

translations.literal: For merit he was granted the imperial surname, removed from the palace register, and attached to the Horizontal-Banner Younger-Father house.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he was granted the imperial surname, removed from the palace register, and attached to the Horizontal-Banner Younger-Father house.

sentences.zh: 贈尚書令，謚文忠。

translations.literal: Posthumously made Minister President and given the posthumous name Wenzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously made Minister President and given the posthumous name Wenzhong.

sentences.zh: 無子，以皇族魏王貼不子耶魯為嗣，早卒，天祚皇帝又以皇子敖魯斡繼之。

translations.literal: He had no sons; the imperial clansman Prince of Wei Tiebu's son Yelu was made heir but died young, and Emperor Tianzuo then made Prince Aoluwo his successor.
translations.idiomatic: He had no sons; the imperial clansman Prince of Wei Tiebu's son Yelu was made heir but died young, and Emperor Tianzuo then made Prince Aoluwo his successor.

sentences.zh: 官給葬具，建廟乾陵側。

translations.literal: The state supplied funeral goods and a temple was built beside Qianling.
translations.idiomatic: The state supplied funeral goods and a temple was built beside Qianling.

sentences.zh: 擬諸宮例，建文忠王府。

translations.literal: Following the precedent of the palaces, the Wenzhong Princely Residence was established.
translations.idiomatic: Following the precedent of the palaces, the Wenzhong Princely Residence was established.

sentences.zh: 正戶五千，蕃漢轉戶八千，出騎軍一萬。

translations.literal: Regular households 5,000; tribal and Han rotational households 8,000; producing 10,000 cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Regular households 5,000; tribal and Han rotational households 8,000; fielding 10,000 cavalry.

sentences.zh: 州一。

translations.literal: Prefecture: one.
translations.idiomatic: One prefecture.

sentences.zh: 提轄司六：上京、中京、南京、西京、奉聖州、平州。

translations.literal: Six supervisory offices: Shangjing, Zhongjing, Nanjing, Xijing, Fengsheng prefecture, and Ping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Six supervisory offices: Shangjing, Zhongjing, Nanjing, Xijing, Fengsheng prefecture, and Ping prefecture.

sentences.zh: 著帳郎君

translations.literal: Registered-Household Gentlemen
translations.idiomatic: Registered-Household Gentlemen

sentences.zh: 著帳郎君：初，遙輦痕德堇可汗以蒲古只等三族害於越釋魯，籍沒家屬入瓦裏。

translations.literal: Registered-household gentlemen: at first, when Yaolian Hendejin Khan had the three clans of Puguzhi and others kill Yuyue Shilu, their families were confiscated and entered the wali.
translations.idiomatic: Registered-household gentlemen: At first, when Yaolian Hendejin Khan had the three clans of Puguzhi and others kill Yuyue Shilu, their families were confiscated and entered the wali.

sentences.zh: 淳欽皇后有之，以為著帳郎君。

translations.literal: Empress Chunqin took charge of them and made them registered-household gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Chunqin took charge of them and made them registered-household gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 世宗悉免。

translations.literal: Shizong pardoned them all.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong pardoned them all.

sentences.zh: 從族、戚、世官犯罪者沒入。

translations.literal: Those of collateral clans, affinal kin, and hereditary offices who committed crimes were confiscated and entered.
translations.idiomatic: Those of collateral clans, affinal kin, and hereditary offices who committed crimes were confiscated and entered.

sentences.zh: 著帳戶

translations.literal: Registered Households
translations.idiomatic: Registered Households

sentences.zh: 著帳戶：本諸斡魯朵析出，及諸罪沒入者。

translations.literal: Registered households: originally drawn out from the various orudo, and those confiscated for various crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Registered households: originally drawn out from the various orudo, and those confiscated for various crimes.

sentences.zh: 凡承應小底、司藏、鷹坊、湯藥、尚飲、盥漱、尚膳、尚衣、裁造等役，及宮中、親王祗從，伶官之屬，皆充之。

translations.literal: All duties such as attendant pages, treasury keepers, hawk yards, medicinal broths, beverage service, washing, cuisine, wardrobe, tailoring, and the like, as well as palace and princely attendants and actors, were filled from them.
translations.idiomatic: All duties such as attendant pages, treasury keepers, hawk yards, medicinal broths, beverage service, washing, cuisine, wardrobe, tailoring, and the like, as well as palace and princely attendants and actors, were filled from them.

sentences.zh: 凡諸宮衛人丁四十萬八千，騎軍十萬一千。

translations.literal: In all the palace guards had 408,000 persons and 101,000 cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In all the palace guards had 408,000 persons and 101,000 cavalry.

sentences.zh: 著帳釋宥、沒入，隨時增損，無常額。

translations.literal: Registered households pardoned or confiscated increased or decreased with the times; there was no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Registered households pardoned or confiscated increased or decreased with the times; there was no fixed quota.
